answer: Resist Sybils with a non-transferable work passport: an agent gains influence only by finishing verified jobs for many distinct counterparties, and every job leaves a ferrous, tamper-evident entry on its record that cannot be copied to a fresh identity. Influence rests on this mesa of accumulated history rather than on how many accounts exist, and it decays during idleness, so sock puppets that stop working wander out of power. Forging one Sybil then costs as much real time and compute as running a genuine agent, which makes mass fakery uneconomical.
